claim: A Claude Code plugin can register a SessionStart command hook in hooks/hooks.json alongside modules, with CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, and its stdout reaches the model as context
subject: claude-code@2.1.325
conclusion: Yes: hooks.json can hold modules and hooks.SessionStart together, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is set, plain stdout and JSON additionalContext reach the model; mod session.start cannot inject context. User-visible display (systemMessage) not observed in a TUI.

claim: A background subagent dispatched with the Agent tool can invoke another plugin's skill (ponytail:ponytail-audit) via the Skill tool and return its report text
subject: claude-code@2.1.325
conclusion: Yes: a background general-purpose subagent called Skill ponytail:ponytail-audit and returned the report; docs say plugin skills are reachable by subagents, context:fork skills run their own background subagent, disable-model-invocation skills cannot be model-invoked, only skills (plus /init, /security-review) are Skill-tool reachable, not arbitrary slash commands.
